value.body: A B.Tech branch built on computer science, with extra depth in statistics, databases, data mining, machine learning, big-data tools and visualisation. Colleges run it under names such as Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Data Science, or CSE (Data Science). Graduates work in analytics, data engineering, machine learning and general software roles.

items.note: 8 semesters; diploma holders can join year 2 through lateral entry

value.title: How you get in
value.body: You choose the branch at counselling, after the entrance exam. JEE Main rank is used for NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded institutes, allotted through JoSAA; JEE Advanced rank for IITs where the branch is offered. State colleges use state counselling with a state CET (EAMCET, MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE and others) or, in Tamil Nadu (TNEA), Class 12 marks. Private universities may run their own tests. Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics is required.

value.title: At a glance
items: Coursework overlaps heavily with CSE, and placements are usually open to the same software and analytics roles.
Fresher data jobs often carry analyst titles; data scientist roles more often ask for experience or a master's.
Government technical posts often list eligible branches by name (CSE, IT); check each notice for whether data-science degrees are included.
Common next steps: a job, GATE → M.Tech, an MS abroad, or an MBA.
